correctness.rationale: For U unitary, direct Frobenius inner product gives ||U-U_:j U_i:/U_ij||_F^2=n-2+|U_ij|^-2. Under strict threshold t>sqrt(b_n), event is |U_ij|^2<delta, with delta=1/[n(t^2-1)+2]<min(1/n,4/n^2). Each row needs a large entry, hence strictly fewer than n(n-1)*delta/n probability. A complex phase rank-one update of I with flat unit vector produces n(n-1) offdiagonal squared amplitudes q↑delta, yielding exact supremum (n-1)delta, not attained; tail constant (n-1)/n. Independently recomputed pivot norms, sampled probabilities, and unitarity for 15 (n,t) values.
residual_risks: Strict threshold and complex-unitary family essential; no result below explicit b_n or for nonunitary/multistep/roundoff inputs.
